acceptanceCriteria: commitBinding is OBSERVED when the hand-off checkpoint commit resolves in the store repository, with a test
packet history offers a deterministic cursor/offset beyond 200 events and names the truncation, with a test
body: Residual from #1189 (V1-1885/1886, ERG-V0-017..021). The review packet's hand-off note checkpoint always reports commitBinding NOT_OBSERVED even when the checkpoint commit is reachable, and packet history truncates at 200 events with no cursor, so long-lived tickets lose earlier review context silently beyond the truncation marker.
title: Review packet: hand-off checkpoint commitBinding always NOT_OBSERVED and packet history capped at 200 events with no paging
